name: Rivertree STF Synergies Berhad
overview: Rivertree STF Synergies Berhad 今年完成改名，并推进多项收购与出售：拟以现金收购 Rivertree Landmark 和 Rivertree Signatures 全部股权，同时出售 Irama Setia 全部股权；建筑板块方面，子公司 RSSB Builders 获得 Q Centre (Teratai) 的土方、打桩及桩帽工程合约，合同金额 RM2,255,595.31。
overview_en: Rivertree STF Synergies Berhad completed its name change this year and is pursuing several acquisitions and a disposal: proposed cash acquisitions of 100% equity in Rivertree Landmark and Rivertree Signatures, and proposed disposal of 100% equity in Irama Setia; it also signed a heads of agreement to acquire Q Centre Management and proposed diversifying into the centralised labour quarters (CLQ) management business.

segments.name: 房地产开发与建设
segments.note: 今年拟通过收购 Rivertree Landmark 和 Rivertree Signatures 全部股权扩大房地产开发业务，同时拟出售 Irama Setia 全部股权。
segments.note_en: This year the group proposed to expand property development via acquisitions of 100% equity in Rivertree Landmark and Rivertree Signatures, while proposing to dispose of 100% equity in Irama Setia.

actions.title: Circular to Shareholders in relation to the: (i) Proposed Acquisition by Rivertree STF Synergies Berhad (formerly known as Sinmah Capital Be
actions.text: 拟以 RM12,972,000 现金出售 Irama Setia Sdn Bhd 100% 股权。
actions.text_en: Proposed disposal of 100% equity interest in Irama Setia Sdn Bhd for RM12,972,000 cash.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 拟以 RM32,717,000 现金收购 Rivertree Landmark Sdn Bhd 100% 股权。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition of 100% equity interest in Rivertree Landmark Sdn Bhd for RM32,717,000 cash.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 拟以 RM13,571,000 现金收购 Rivertree Signatures Sdn Bhd 100% 股权。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition of 100% equity interest in Rivertree Signatures Sdn Bhd for RM13,571,000 cash.

segments.name: 建筑与承包
segments.note: 今年子公司 RSSB Builders 获得 Q Centre (Teratai) 的土方、打桩及桩帽工程合约。
segments.note_en: This year subsidiary RSSB Builders secured a contract from Q Centre (Teratai) for earthwork, piling and pile cap works.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 接受 Q Centre (Teratai) Sdn Bhd 的授标函，承接两栋共 4,560 个床位的劳工宿舍（含健身房和商店）的土方、打桩及桩帽工程，合同金额 RM2,255,595.31。
actions.text_en: Accepted a letter of award from Q Centre (Teratai) Sdn Bhd for earthwork, piling and pile cap works for two blocks of labour quarters with 4,560 beds (including a gymnasium and a shop) for a contract sum of RM2,255,595.31.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note_en: This year the company changed its name, and proposed to acquire Q Centre Management and diversify into the centralised labour quarters (CLQ) management business.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 签署协议拟收购 Q Centre Management Sdn Bhd 最多 100% 股权。
actions.text_en: Signed a heads of agreement to acquire up to 100% equity interest in Q Centre Management Sdn Bhd and proposed to diversify existing principal activities to include the management and operation of centralised labour quarters (CLQ).

actions.title: Change of Company Name - RIVERTREE STF SYNERGIES BERHAD
actions.text: 公司名称由 Sinmah Capital Berhad 更改为 Rivertree STF Synergies Berhad。
actions.text_en: Changed company name from Sinmah Capital Berhad to Rivertree STF Synergies Berhad.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text: 并拟收购 Q Centre Management Sdn Bhd 最多 100% 股权。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed diversification of existing principal activities to include the centralised labour quarters (CLQ) management business, and proposed acquisition of up to 100% equity interest in Q Centre Management Sdn Bhd.
